open_obligations: Note that Du et al. generate answers, while Cohen et al. classify claims as correct or incorrect.
Check whether Du et al.'s biography grading by ChatGPT is reliable enough to compare with Cohen et al.'s gold labels.
Check for a majority-vote baseline, which Du et al. omit on these factuality tasks.
out.other_title: Future work: multiple examiners, trained examiners, and analysing model beliefs
out.rationale: Cohen et al. propose using several LM instances in factuality detection instead of one examiner. Du et al. report multi-agent debate among ChatGPT copies improves factual accuracy (biographies 66.0 to 73.8, MMLU 63.9 to 71.1 versus single agent); this improves answer generation by consensus, not detection of another model's false claims.
out.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether several LM instances interacting improve factuality judgements over a single model, for ChatGPT on biographies and MMLU
